desc:
Welcome to Steal From Jujutsu⚡🌀

Infiltrate enemy bases and steal powerful JJK characters! 🤫👁️
Escape while dangerous cursed guards chase you down! 🏃‍♂️💨
Secure them in your base and watch your rewards grow! 💰

⚡ Your JJK characters generate rewards even while you're OFFLINE! 💤

Enjoying the game? 👍 Drop a like and bring your friends into the chaos! 😄
